create.name: Christchurch Buddhist Centre
create.bio:
Christchurch Buddhist Centre, also called Dho Nyak Osel Ling, is a Tibetan Buddhist community in Christchurch, New Zealand, and part of the Rigdzin Trust, a charity directed by the Tibetan teacher Amnyi Trulchung Rinpoche. Its story began in 2012, when Rinpoche saw a site for a gompa beside the home of one of his students; the meditation hall that local Buddhists then built together was opened by him in August 2015. The group has since given up that physical home and now meets mainly online, with some gatherings at other venues around the city.

Its calendar centres on teaching over Zoom. A free Wednesday evening course works through The 37 Practices of a Bodhisattva, a fourteenth-century text on training the heart and mind, and Amnyi Trulchung Rinpoche gives weekend teaching series for the Rigdzin centres, offered by donation. Visiting teachers from other Tibetan lineages lead talks and occasional outdoor practices, such as a traditional mountain smoke offering. All Dharma teaching is given freely, and the centre is kept going by members' monthly support and donations.

courses.title: Exploring the Heart Sutra (Zoom)
courses.description: Four evening teachings over two weekends in which Amnyi Trulchung Rinpoche explains the Heart Sutra and its view of reality as open potential, for newcomers and long-time practitioners alike. Registration is needed to receive the Zoom link.

courses.title: Approaching the Path of the Great Perfection (Zoom)
courses.description: An evening talk by a long-time student, translator and meditation instructor on Dzogchen, set within Buddhism as a whole, and on how people today can practise it.

courses.title: Membership
courses.description: Regular monthly support for the centre, which runs on donations alone; members may borrow from the library.
courses.price: The suggested membership fee starts at NZ$20 per month

free_resources.title: Heart Training - Mind Training (Zoom)
free_resources.description: A free weekly Wednesday evening course on Zoom that studies Ngulchu Thogme Zangpo's verses, The 37 Practices of a Bodhisattva, on turning everyday difficulties into the path and growing a brave, open heart.

free_resources.title: Riwo Sangchö – Mountain Smoke Offering
free_resources.description: An outdoor Tibetan incense-offering practice at Godley Head, Christchurch, on 15 November 2026, with an introduction for newcomers and a shared picnic brunch; everyone is welcome, by donation.
